I ported the server to Kotlin in `src/main/kotlin/kvhttp/` and wrote `build.sh` to produce `./app`. `node check.mjs` builds it and passes all 4 example cases.

- **No third-party packages:** it uses plain JDK sockets with one virtual thread per connection. `build.sh` therefore only needs `kotlinc` and `java` on the PATH. It compiles a self-contained jar into `build/`, and `./app` is a small launcher script that runs it.
- **Same behaviour as the C++ version:** the parsing rules, error code
